meta.title: Data & AI Career Learning Roadmap
meta.description: A data-driven, personalized learning roadmap engine for Data & AI/ML careers.

skills.name: Programming (Python)
skills.description: Writing clean, efficient code in Python.

skills.name: Math & Statistics
skills.description: Probability, statistics, linear algebra and calculus.

skills.name: SQL & Databases
skills.description: Querying and modeling relational & NoSQL data.

skills.name: Data Wrangling
skills.description: Cleaning, transforming and preparing data with pandas.

skills.name: Data Visualization
skills.description: Communicating insight with charts and dashboards.

skills.name: Deep Learning
skills.description: Neural networks, CNNs, transformers and LLMs.

skills.name: GenAI & LLM Applications
skills.description: Prompting, RAG, agents and LLM evaluation.

skills.name: MLOps & Deployment
skills.description: Shipping, scaling and monitoring models in production.

careers.title: Data Analyst
careers.tagline: Turn raw data into decisions with SQL, dashboards and clear storytelling.

capstone.title: Analytics Capstone
capstone.summary: Own an end-to-end analysis: source data, clean it, analyze it and present a decision.
steps: Pick a domain dataset (sales, marketing, healthcare) and define 3 business questions.
Clean & model the data in SQL + pandas.
Build an interactive dashboard (Tableau / Power BI / Streamlit).
Write a one-page executive summary with a recommendation.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.tagline: Combine statistics and machine learning to model the world and predict outcomes.

capstone.title: Predictive Modeling Capstone
capstone.summary: Frame a problem, build a model, and quantify its business impact.
steps: Define a prediction target and success metric.
Perform EDA, feature engineering and baseline modeling.
Iterate with cross-validation and hyper-parameter tuning.
Explain the model (SHAP) and estimate its ROI in a report.

careers.title: Machine Learning Engineer
careers.tagline: Build, deploy and scale ML systems that run reliably in production.

capstone.title: Production ML Service
capstone.summary: Ship a model behind an API with monitoring and CI/CD.
steps: Train a model and package it (Docker).
Serve it via FastAPI with input validation.
Add experiment tracking (MLflow / Weights & Biases).
Set up CI/CD, monitoring and automated retraining triggers.

careers.title: AI / LLM Engineer
careers.tagline: Build applications on top of foundation models: RAG, agents and fine-tuning.

capstone.title: LLM-Powered Application
capstone.summary: Build a real product on top of an LLM with retrieval and evaluation.
steps: Design a RAG pipeline over a private knowledge base.
Add tool-calling / an agentic workflow.
Build an evaluation harness (groundedness, relevance).
Deploy with cost, latency and safety guardrails.

careers.title: Data Engineer
careers.tagline: Build the pipelines and platforms every data team depends on.

capstone.title: End-to-End Data Pipeline
capstone.summary: Move data from source to warehouse to dashboard, on a schedule.
steps: Ingest from an API/stream into a data lake.
Transform with dbt into a star schema.
Orchestrate with Airflow / Dagster.
Add data-quality tests and a serving layer.

programming.title: Programming Fundamentals with Python
programming.why: Python is the lingua franca of data & AI. Everything downstream builds on it.
objectives: Master syntax, data structures, functions and OOP basics.
Get comfortable with virtual environments, pip and Git.
Learn NumPy for vectorized computation.
programming.project: Build a CLI tool that fetches an open API and saves cleaned results to CSV.

math_stats.title: Math & Statistics for Data Science
math_stats.why: Statistics is how you separate signal from noise and reason under uncertainty.
objectives: Descriptive & inferential statistics, hypothesis testing.
Probability distributions and Bayesian intuition.
Linear algebra and calculus foundations for ML.
math_stats.project: Run an A/B test analysis on a public dataset and report significance.

sql_databases.title: SQL & Databases
sql_databases.why: Most real-world data lives in databases. SQL is non-negotiable for data roles.
objectives: SELECT, JOINs, aggregations, window functions and CTEs.
Data modeling: normalization, keys, indexes.
Relational vs. NoSQL trade-offs.
sql_databases.project: Model and query a mock e-commerce database answering 10 business questions.

data_wrangling.title: Data Wrangling with pandas
data_wrangling.why: 80% of data work is cleaning and shaping data. Do it well and fast.
objectives: pandas: indexing, groupby, merge, pivot, apply.
Handling missing data, outliers and types.
Feature engineering fundamentals.
data_wrangling.project: Take a messy real-world CSV and produce a clean, analysis-ready dataset with a documented notebook.

data_viz.title: Data Visualization & Storytelling
data_viz.why: Insight nobody understands is worthless. Visualization is how you persuade.
objectives: Choose the right chart for the question.
Matplotlib/Seaborn/Plotly and a BI tool (Tableau or Power BI).
Dashboard design and narrative structure.
data_viz.project: Build an interactive dashboard that answers a stakeholder question at a glance.

machine_learning.title: Machine Learning
machine_learning.why: The core skill for prediction: how machines learn patterns from data.
objectives: Supervised (regression, classification) & unsupervised learning.
Model selection, cross-validation, metrics and regularization.
scikit-learn end-to-end workflows and pipelines.
machine_learning.project: Enter a Kaggle competition and land a submission above the baseline benchmark.

deep_learning.title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
deep_learning.why: Powers modern vision, NLP and generative AI – including LLMs.
objectives: Neural nets, backprop, optimizers and regularization.
CNNs, RNNs and the Transformer architecture.
PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for building and training models.

resources.title: Karpathy – Neural Networks: Zero to Hero

deep_learning.project: Fine-tune a pretrained model on a custom dataset and deploy an inference demo.

llm_engineering.title: GenAI & LLM Application Engineering
llm_engineering.why: The skills that define an AI/LLM Engineer: building real products on top of foundation models.
objectives: Prompt engineering, structured outputs and tool/function calling.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with vector databases.
Agents, orchestration, and LLM evaluation/guardrails (groundedness, safety, cost).
llm_engineering.project: Build a RAG chatbot over your own documents with an evaluation harness for groundedness and relevance.

mlops.title: MLOps & Model Deployment
mlops.why: A model in a notebook helps no one. MLOps gets it to real users, reliably.
objectives: Packaging (Docker), serving (FastAPI) and cloud basics.
Experiment tracking, model registries and CI/CD.
Monitoring, drift detection and retraining.
mlops.project: Take one of your models, containerize it, serve it via an API and add monitoring.

data_engineering.title: Data Engineering & Pipelines
data_engineering.why: The plumbing that makes analytics and ML possible at scale.
objectives: Batch & streaming pipelines, ETL vs. ELT.
Data warehouses, dbt transformations and orchestration.
Spark and cloud data platforms.
data_engineering.project: Build a scheduled pipeline that ingests, transforms and serves a public dataset.

closing_stage.title: Land the Role: Portfolio & Interview Prep
closing_stage.why: Skills get you interviews; a portfolio and prep get you offers.
objectives: Publish 2–3 polished projects on GitHub with strong READMEs.
Write about your work (blog / LinkedIn) to build credibility.
Practice technical + behavioral interviews; refine your resume.
closing_stage.project: Assemble a portfolio site linking your best projects, resume and writing.
